name: budget
description: Local money tracker (SQLite, nothing leaves the PC): log an expense or income with a category, set monthly category limits, see this month's spend by category, list recent transactions. 'spent 1200 on groceries' just works; limits warn at 80% and 100%.
route: spent X on Y, logged an expense, add income, set a limit for, this month's spending, my expenses, spending summary
